caption:
📌 Save this Mardin itinerary for your trip to Türkiye 🇹🇷🤎

✨ TOP THINGS TO SEE
🏘️ Mardin Old Town – Explore the beautiful stone streets
🏛️ Zinciriye Medresesi – Incredible views over the city
🕌 Kasimiye Medresesi – Stunning architecture and history
⛪ Ulu Cami – Mardin’s historic Great Mosque
🕯️ Kırklar Church – Discover the city’s Syriac heritage
🏰 Old PTT Building – Admire beautiful stone architecture
🛍️ Old Mardin bazaars – Wander through traditional markets
✝️ Deyrulzafaran Monastery – Discover the history of the Syriac community
🙏 Mor Gabriel Monastery – Visit an ancient monastery near Midyat
🏺 Dara Ancient City – Explore ancient ruins and an impressive underground cistern
📜 Mardin Museum – Learn more about the city’s history

🌅 BEST ROOFTOPS
☕ Matera – Climb up for amazing views over the old city
🍹 Seyr-i Merdin Terrace – Enjoy beautiful views from the heart of the Old Town

🏨 WHERE TO STAY
🛏️ Izala Hotel – Stay in a traditional stone building in the Old Town

🍽️ WHERE TO EAT
🥘 Cercis Murat Konagi – Try local cuisine with a gourmet touch
💃 Hamdani Restaurant – Enjoy dinner with live music and performances
🌇 Kasr-i Bagdadi – Savour local food with beautiful views

🤎 Don’t rush your visit. Get lost in the narrow streets, enjoy the rooftops at sunset and take time to meet the incredibly welcoming locals

✈️ The easiest way to get to Mardin is to fly directly from Istanbul with @turkishairlines to Mardin with a flight time of around 2 hours

Discover more hidden gems in Türkiye and follow @goturkiye on Instagram for more travel inspiration

The dream became reality – I finally made it to Namibia. 🇳🇦

I spent the past week on a road trip through southern Namibia together with @dertour_de. I was dreaming about visiting this country for years and now I finally got the chance as part of #challengeimparadise 2.0. Together with my teammates @michaelxscn and @haktanalbayrak, we competed against two other teams to win the challenge.

Our route took us from Windhoek to the Kalahari Desert, where we saw so many wild animals (the giraffes at sunset were definitely my highlight). We continued further south to Aus with even more wildlife, took in the impressive views of Fish River Canyon and eventually made it to a place that had been on my bucket list for a long time: the Namib Desert and Deadvlei. Early in the morning I finally got to photograph the dead trees before it was time to hit the road once again towards Swakopmund to meet up with all the other creators.

Looking back on this journey, I feel extremely grateful to have seen all these amazing places and so much incredible nature. Thanks to my great team, we actually won the challenge in the end. However, one thing is for sure: it definitely wasn’t my last time in Namibia.

Humans and nature belong together.
A night out in Berlin 🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛

Maldivas también es esto.
Llevamos días con lluvia, cielo gris y un mar que no se parece al de las fotos que todos tenemos en la cabeza.
Al principio cuesta. Vienes con una idea muy concreta del sitio y la realidad no coincide.
Pero con los días he empezado a verlo de otra forma. La luz cambia, el ritmo baja, y el lugar se muestra tal como es, sin la versión de postal.
No siempre hay sol ni condiciones perfectas. Y aun así, tiene su encanto.

Brands don’t just pay for a nice photo, they pay for the right photos.
 
Swipe through for the shots worth getting on every shoot. Add a person so viewers can picture themselves there. Get in close on hands and textures. Shoot through a window or leaves for depth, and finish with one wide or aerial shot of the whole place.
 
Quick tip: shoot each one in vertical as well as horizontal. Most brand content ends up in stories and reels, so a vertical version is an easy bonus.

to remain in awe of nature

me, you and winter in Hokkaido!? A few days ago we had the first snow of the season and i’ve been itching to go back! The landscape is absolutely extraordinary yet there is still lots of christmas spirit and gorgeous cozy interiors. I think its a breath of fresh air compared to christmas season in europe (also probably better 👀) and there is so much to see! Some of the places in these postcards are biei, otaru, shirahige falls, ningle terrace and literally random side streets in the cities! I havent even mentioned snow sports too but you should get out there and explore it for yourself #travel #japan #cinematic #hokkaido
